name: PolicyAcceptanceReader
tagline: The Policy Acceptance Reader puts a policy, code of conduct or set of terms directly on a form, and records that the person has read and accepted it.
description: The Policy Acceptance Reader puts a policy, code of conduct or set of terms directly on a form, and records that the person has read and accepted it. The text is split into numbered sections with a contents list, a search box and a reading progress bar. You decide the rules: people may have to read to the end, tick the important sections, and sign by typing their name. The control saves the version they accepted, when, and who signed, and asks them to accept again when you publish a new version.
features: Search with highlighted matches, reading progress
Checkbox or typed-name signature, version re-acceptance, withdraw
Read-only and masked states and a phone layout
Stores a JSON acceptance record (version, date, name, acknowledged sections)
